metadata.chapter: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES

content.title: Chapter 94 - STREETS, SIDEWALKS AND CERTAIN OTHER PUBLIC PLACES — Sec. 94-160. - Taper section of curb cuts.
content.summary:
The taper section of the curb cut under this article shall not extend beyond the property
               line.
(Code 1981, § 30-145; Ord. No. 1544, § 4(F), 3-19-1979)
